title: Accessibility and user feedback
outcome: Explain accessibility and user feedback using the deciding step in this fictional service.
scenario: Make feedback accessible. An app marks an incomplete answer with a red circle only; a revision adds equivalent text and keyboard access.
given: New text: "More explanation needed". The next-action link is labelled and focusable; status is exposed to assistive technology.

steps.label: Find the barrier
steps.detail: Colour alone may not communicate the status to every learner.

steps.label: Provide meaning
steps.detail: Text and programmatic status explain the same result.

steps.label: Test next action
steps.detail: A keyboard user can reach the labelled explanation link.

explanation: Accessibility offers the same meaning and actions through usable channels. Feedback should say what to improve, not merely show a mark.

counterfactual.change: Change the circle to orange without labels.
counterfactual.reason: A different hue supplies no textual or programmatic equivalent.

student_task: Explain what each text, keyboard and assistive-technology change adds to the feedback. Why does changing the red circle to orange alone not solve the communication barrier?
teacher_answer: Colour alone may not communicate the status to every learner. Text and programmatic status explain the same result. A keyboard user can reach the labelled explanation link. Changed case: The colour-only communication barrier remains. A different hue supplies no textual or programmatic equivalent.
project_evidence: For the Grounded Learning Service, retain an annotated trace and the changed-case result. Name the contract or evidence that makes the deciding step valid, so another team can review it.
limits: One keyboard check is not a complete accessibility audit; test relevant assistive technologies and gather user feedback.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice, distinct from the reserved independent case. These stipulated records illustrate reasoning; no real service execution or learner outcome is claimed.
